name: Colonia del Sacramento, Uruguay

rent.notes: InfoCasas Colonia del Sacramento 2BR listings (Nov 2026): houses and apartments 18,000-32,000 UYU/month (about 450-800 USD) incl. some gastos comunes of 500-4,000 UYU; a 2BR house on Ruta 21 at 800 USD; rambla-front new apartments ~32,000 UYU plus 4,000 GC. Typical is a 2-3BR house with yard suitable for a large dog.

groceries.notes: Montevideo Numbeo (Nov 2026, 73 contributors): single-person monthly costs excl. rent 969 USD; Expatistan May 2026 milk 54 UYU/l, eggs 231 UYU/dozen, chicken breast 246 UYU/500g. Food for two about 450-520 USD plus food for a 45 kg dog: cuantomecuesta mid-range dog food 4,500 UYU/mo x1.6 large-dog factor = ~7,200 UYU (about 180 USD), economy 4,800 UYU (~120 USD). CPI 4.68% y/y Sep 2026 so no basket shock. Colonia is a smaller market with slightly lower prices than Montevideo but limited supermarket choice; set a little below Montevideo.

utilities.notes: UTE Residencial Simple from 30 Apr 2026: fixed 324.90 UYU, 83.20 UYU/kW, 6.74 UYU/kWh to 100 kWh, 8.45 to 600, plus 22% VAT; ~300 kWh is about 3,600 UYU (90 USD), ~500 kWh with electric heating in winter about 6,700 UYU (170 USD). OSE water/sewer tariffs rose Jan 2026 (roughly 1,000-1,300 UYU for a household); supergas cylinder for cooking/heating adds 10-25 USD. Trash is funded via owner-paid municipal tax. Numbeo Montevideo 85m2 utilities 188 USD, Expatistan 5,023 UYU (125 USD). Colonia houses rely on electric or supergas heating in winter, so set near Montevideo level.

healthcare.notes: Resident retirees without BPS/FONASA affiliation pay a mutualista (IAMC) individual cuota directly: Asociacion Espanola 3,869 UYU/mo (Jul 2026), Medica Uruguaya ~3,200, CASMU ~3,400, i.e. about 90-97 USD per adult at ~40 UYU/USD, plus an emergencia movil plan (~272 UYU/adult). Typical = two mutualista cuotas plus emergencia movil; max = two adults in a private hospital plan such as Hospital Britanico (14,254-21,501 UYU per adult, joining age limit 60). Regulated copays (190-968 UYU per consult, 880 UYU ticket cap) are carried in medicalOOP. Max capped at 3x typical by the refresh QA pass (premium international plans can run higher).

petCare.notes: Large dog: annual vaccine package (sextuple + rabies) 2,100-2,600 UYU, quarterly flea/tick/worm treatment 1,500-2,200 UYU each (6,000-9,000/yr), 2 vet visits at 1,200-2,800 UYU; roughly 16,000-22,000 UYU/yr (about 400-550 USD), averaged with a margin for incidentals. Municipal (IMM) clinics are free for registered pets.

transportation.notes: Small town; a car is useful. Nafta Super 90.45 UYU/l (Nov 2026, about 2.25 USD/l): ~40 l/month = 3,600 UYU (90 USD); terceros completo insurance 1,385-1,550 UYU/month (~37 USD); annual patente (vehicle tax, ~4.5% of fiscal value) and maintenance add roughly 60-90 USD/month (patente share estimated, not separately sourced). Local buses and occasional Montevideo trips are cheap. Min = no car.
